extensionDescription.message: Strip the quoted history from your Gmail replies before you send them. Local only, no network.
extensionDescription.description: Store and browser description, 132 characters at most.

barTrim.description: Button in the Gmail compose that removes the quoted history.

barUndo.description: Button that puts the removed quoted history back.

barRemoved.description: Shown after a trim; $COUNT$ is the number of quoted emails removed, possibly with a + when there were more.

barUncertain.message: Trim uncertain: check the quote is gone before sending.
barUncertain.description: Warning shown when Gmail might still append the quote on send.

optionsSubtitle.message: Strip the quoted history from your Gmail replies.

autoLabel.message: Trim the quoted history as soon as a reply opens

autoHint.message: When off, a Trim button is offered in each reply instead.

keepReplied.message: All but the message I am replying to

thresholdLabel.message: Trim automatically only when the quote holds at least this many emails

thresholdHint.message: The Trim button ignores this limit.

barLabel.message: Show what was removed, with Undo, after a trim

barHint.message: The Trim button and the uncertain-trim warning are always shown.

areaHint.message: Only the settings are synced. The counter and your emails never leave this browser.

accessMissing.message: TrimReply has no access to mail.google.com: it does nothing in Gmail.

accessRefused.message: The browser refused the request: grant it from the extension's site access settings.
